step 1: add docker apt key
  docker: add Docker's apt signing key at /etc/apt/keyrings/docker.asc
  run:
    $ set -e
    $ export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
    $ apt-get -o DPkg::Lock::Timeout=300 update
    $ apt-get -o DPkg::Lock::Timeout=300 install -y ca-certificates curl
    $ install -m 0755 -d /etc/apt/keyrings
    $ curl -fsSL https://download.docker.com/linux/ubuntu/gpg -o /etc/apt/keyrings/docker.asc.paisans-tmp
    $ chmod a+r /etc/apt/keyrings/docker.asc.paisans-tmp
    $ mv /etc/apt/keyrings/docker.asc.paisans-tmp /etc/apt/keyrings/docker.asc

step 2: add docker apt repo
  docker: add Docker's apt repository for noble/amd64 at /etc/apt/sources.list.d/docker.sources
  write /etc/apt/sources.list.d/docker.sources mode 0644:
    | Types: deb
    | URIs: https://download.docker.com/linux/ubuntu
    | Suites: noble
    | Components: stable
    | Architectures: amd64
    | Signed-By: /etc/apt/keyrings/docker.asc
